thread.title: Best Sicilian Wines of 2025 - NewsBreak

author: briannecohen.com
title: Best Sicilian Wines of 2025 - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago In May 2025, I returned to Sicily for Sicilia en Primeur, the island’s annual press event where producers from across the region share new releases with wine journalists from around the world. Sicilia en Primeur is part tasting, part storytelling, and part immersion in the culture, landscapes, and people behind the wines. We spend a couple of days in a conference room, tasting wines one after the other in a sterile, uninspiring environment (that is the reality of large, multi-day tastings). But we also break into small groups and visit a handful of wineries over a few days. This is where the good stuff happens. Here, you see and taste wines at their source and meet the people behind them. I’ve now been to this magical island a handful of times, and somehow it still manages to surprise me every single visit. I am never not impressed by the wines, but also by the place itself and the warmth, pride, and generosity of the people who call it home. These are my favorite Sicilian wines of 2025, bottles that stayed with me long after the trip ended and continue to pull me right back to the island. Read full article
